title: Default layouts
intro: These settings are the starting point for EVERY scenario of the chosen game type. A scenario that sets its own value keeps it; the rest follow this page. Positions are stored element by element: only the ones you move are saved, everything else keeps following the layout shipped with the app.
saved: Defaults saved. The postes de jeu pick them up on their next sync.
mustBeAdmin: You must be signed in as an admin to save.
notAvailableYet: Not available for this game type yet.
resetElement: Put this element back where the app ships it
positionsHint: Drag an element on the screen to move it; select it for a resize handle and its exact values. Everything is a percentage of the 16:9 screen.
typographySubtitle: Click a text on the screen to pick its role. These values apply to every Quest scenario that does not set its own.
typographyFooter: Size is a percentage of the authored size. A scenario can override each setting separately from its Aperçu.
mainImageMarginHint: Margin around the completed image (% of the box's shorter side). The green or red result glow follows the image's outline, so with no margin it bleeds onto the template frame. The four-piece grid is not affected.
